title: Security Review: lichen-link 2026-08-16
description:
Security-focused code review of rust/lichen-link/src/lib.rs and all submodules.

## Scope
- rust/lichen-link/src/lib.rs
- rust/lichen-link/src/frame.rs
- rust/lichen-link/src/keys.rs
- rust/lichen-link/src/replay.rs
- rust/lichen-link/src/seqnum.rs
- rust/lichen-link/src/schnorr.rs
- rust/lichen-link/src/identity.rs
- rust/lichen-link/src/trust.rs
- rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs

## Focus Areas
- Injection vulnerabilities: None found (no user input to interpreters)
- Buffer overflow: None found (forbid(unsafe_code), bounds checking, typed errors)
- Crypto misuse: 1 finding (P2) - signer IID bit uses wrong bit position
- Auth bypass: None found (proper signature->replay->pin ordering)
- Input validation gaps: 1 finding (P3) - missing destination address check (likely intentional)

## Confidence Calibration
Review confidence: 15% chance of missed bug in crypto integration.
Least confident areas: schnorr48 crate internals (external dependency), SCHC decompression (different crate).
Would raise confidence if: schnorr48 crate had formal audit, fuzz testing on frame parsing.

## Crypto Dependencies Delegated
- schnorr48: signature creation/verification, keypair derivation
- sha2: IID derivation (via lichen-core)
- subtle: constant-time comparison (via lichen-core)
- zeroize: secret cleanup on drop

These are reviewed by their maintainers; this review covers integration only.
